description: We took what was already the highest specc’d complete BMX bike in the game and gave it a nitrous boost. The ENVY CARBONIC takes the legendary WETHEPEOPLE ENVY and gives it one of the most progressive and game changing technical upgrades ever seen on a complete. Now rolling on the ECLAT CARBONIC carbon fibre rims and with a slick stealth black makeover, the ENVY CARBONIC begins the dawn of a new era in BMX design. Fully laden with only the very best parts from ECLAT including the ECLAT Storm XLT fork, Mirage Tires and ground-breaking Seismic hubs, the ENVY CARBONIC sacrifices no investment. A bike which is set to turn heads and spark intrigue wherever it goes, you’re going to have a hard time deciding if you want to put it in a display case or push it to the absolute limit. AVAILABLE IN 20.5” OR 21” TOPTUBES IN RSD AND LSD. INCLUDES LIFETIME GUARANTEE ON THE FRAME & FORK
